explanation_rider: The driver arrived 2 minutes before the scheduled time and waited 8 minutes. Under policy NS-1.3, the free wait period is 5 minutes; after that a no-show fee applies. The driver made 5 contact attempts and you did not reply, so the charge is upheld.
explanation_driver: You arrived early and waited beyond the 5-minute free wait period. The rider did not respond to 5 contact attempts. Policy NS-1.1, NS-1.3, NS-1.4, NS-1.5, and NS-1.6 support the no-show charge. The ruling is in your favour.
